text: 人民银行上海总部7月29日召开2026年第三季度新闻发布会，介绍今年上半年上海金融运行情况，并回答记者提问。上半年，全市社会融资规模增加6914亿元，较好满足了实体经济的融资需求。6月末，全市本外币贷款余额13.60万亿元，同比增长5.9%。
text_en: On July 29, the PBOC Shanghai Headquarters held a Q3 2026 press conference, reporting H1 Shanghai financial operations. H1 saw aggregate social financing increase by 691.4 billion yuan, meeting real economy financing needs. By end-June, local currency loans stood at 13.60 trillion yuan, up 5.9% year-on-year.
